target_customer: Consumers comparing student loans and other financial products; revenue from lender partners
problem: Students and consumers lacked transparent comparison of lending products.
business_model: Affiliate and lead generation marketplace and content site

founders.name: Nate Matherson
previous_startups: ShopTutors (scrapped tutor booking idea, same company)

founders.name: Matt Lenhard
founders.background_notes: Later co-founder and CTO of ContainIQ per YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Content and comparison website with affiliate integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Comparison sites were easy to copy; search rankings and lender relationships were the only edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A 2022 acquisition is listed by Seedtable with no acquirer; the company site is still copyrighted by Shop Tutors, Inc.

market_need_then: Not independently sourced; large student debt and an existing comparison market were the context, per general coverage.

rebrands.why: The tutor booking idea was dropped in the Iowa accelerator after mentors said it was too small, per Technical.ly.

branding.community_and_virality: FTC settlement over claims of objective rankings is the main press about the brand (date not recorded here)

brand_strength.rationale: The name is descriptive of student lending, but the FTC case on its claims of unbiased information hurt trust.

pivots.why: Mentors in the Iowa Startup Accelerator said the original idea was too small, per Technical.ly.

outcome_analysis: LendEDU pivoted from a tutor booking idea to a student loan comparison site inside the Iowa Startup Accelerator in 2014 and joined YC in Winter 2016. It still operates under Shop Tutors, Inc. and the site claims over 12 years in business. A 2022 acquisition is listed by one aggregator without an acquirer, so the exit is unverified; the FTC also settled with the company over its claims of unbiased rankings.
notes: Exit type follows the YC directory (Acquired); the 2022-07-14 date and unnamed acquirer come only from Seedtable and are unverified. YC deal money of about 120K (CB Insights, Seedtable) is the standard deal and not recorded as a round; no later rounds found. Mergr shows the company itself acquired StatFuse in December 2016. Competitor search returned only current pages, so the list is empty. Education not on YC page.
